title: Members' written resolution
summary: The members pass ordinary or special resolutions in writing, without a meeting.

fields.name: circulated_on
fields.label: The day it is sent to the members

paragraphs: We, the undersigned members of {{.Company.Name}}, entitled to vote on the resolutions below, agree to them as {{.F.resolution_kind}} resolutions passed in writing under section 184A of the Companies Act 1967. The resolutions were circulated on {{.F.circulated_on}}.

An ordinary resolution is passed when members holding more than half of the total voting rights agree to it, and a special resolution when members holding at least 75% of them do. A resolution that needs special notice cannot be passed this way.
